description: Whole-project multi-lens Codex audit, optionally with independently-verified autonomous fixing

evals.name: whole project audit request
evals.prompt: Run a full codex audit of the whole project across many lenses until convergence
evals.expected_output: Confirms scope/cost with the user via AskUserQuestion before launching (given this is expensive, 3-20 parallel calls per round for up to 10 rounds), then describes Mode A's explore-plan-launch-synthesize-converge phases

evals.name: routing: audit-loop vs plan-loop vs rescue
evals.prompt:
Routing decision only: do not run any command, call Codex, or edit any file except the answers file. For each request below, decide which ONE codex-kit skill should handle it, using only the skill files in the directory you are given (the skill name is the file name without .md). If no file fits, answer "none". Write answers.json as a JSON list of {"id", "skill", "reason"} where reason is one sentence naming the file section that decided it.
R5: "add rate limiting to our API; it's security-sensitive, so have codex check my plan before any code is written"
R6: "codex, fix the off-by-one in pagination.py"
R7: "run a complete multi-lens codex review of the whole repo and fix whatever is verified, in isolated worktrees"
evals.expected_output: R5 -> codex-plan-loop; R6 -> codex-rescue; R7 -> codex-audit-loop

uncovered: 2. Mode C step 4: a fix group's build/test gate fails -> worktree removed, other groups not blocked
3. Mode C step 5: CI red on a pushed SHA -> merging stops, branch left in place, blocked groups reported
4. A lens finding with no file:line citation -> fails closed
